requirement: The turn after a stopped one is told, once and across a host restart, which writes landed and which are unknown

oracle.ref: PR #1479 (fix); fix evidence: Review 19/10/2026: after Stop the log said 'tool call aborted' though the write could have landed; the next turn believed nothing changed
oracle.invariant: S1: the next turn gets one notice naming it as landed; a later turn gets none. S2: named as unknown, never landed. S3: no notice.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: 🔒 Q2: an EmDash write lands after Stop, the host restarts, and the next turn is told it landed — once
🔒 Q2: an Apply write whose answer was lost after Stop is named as unknown, never as landed
🔒 Q2: a turn that was not stopped reports nothing and adds no notice; a write Stop kept from being sent is not named
